QUOTE: Default target is `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_STD_CALLOC`/`STD_FREE` if you define them, else an "uninit" stub. Calloc returns NULL and free does nothing until you call `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free()`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that uninitialised pointer defaults are stubs where calloc returns NULL and free does nothing until the setter is called.
